name: Install packed npm CLI and open the empty UI — installed assets or skills missing.
test: Install packed npm CLI and open the empty UI — installed assets or skills missing.

name: Install the Pi package and route a request — wrong skill, workspace, or harness.
test: Install the Pi package and route a request — wrong skill, workspace, or harness.
limit: Pi routes the installed package to a deterministic loopback provider; model judgment is not tested.

name: Discover the packaged Claude plugin and invoke its entry — broken plugin distribution.
test: Discover the packaged Claude plugin and invoke its entry — broken plugin distribution.
limit: The installed plugin bundle is invoked directly; a real Claude host is not exercised.

name: Run a new ticket against a local URL — hidden assumptions or missing successful receipt.
test: Record a defect with replayable evidence — report text cannot become a reviewable claim.

name: Recover after missing host or missing ticket source — unexplained partial records or duplicates.
test: Recover after missing host or missing ticket source — unexplained partial records or duplicates.

name: Pick an active instance and refuse unsafe defaults — mutation scope or selected URL is wrong.
test: Pick an active instance and refuse unsafe defaults — mutation scope or selected URL is wrong.

name: Record a defect with replayable evidence — report text cannot become a reviewable claim.
test: Record a defect with replayable evidence — report text cannot become a reviewable claim.

name: Explore a clean fixture — invented defect or missing observed coverage.
test: Explore a clean fixture — invented defect or missing observed coverage.
limit: Controlled replay does not measure live model false positives.

name: Keep incomplete criteria unverified — false green.
test: Keep incomplete criteria unverified — false green.

name: Merge duplicate findings and preserve evidence — defect inflated or unique evidence dropped.
test: Merge duplicate findings and preserve evidence — defect inflated or unique evidence dropped.

name: Run a fixed-build retest — old finding remains open or source build changes.
test: Record a defect with replayable evidence — report text cannot become a reviewable claim.

name: Show disputed/failed retest without closing a claim — unresolved defect reported fixed.
test: Show disputed/failed retest without closing a claim — unresolved defect reported fixed.

name: Answer a blocking question and update the next actor — stalled workflow.
test: 13–16 packaged oracle answers update the handoff, and the UI reflects the same record

name: Offer the same follow-up in CLI and UI — older eligible exploration omitted.
test: 14 CLI and UI expose the same eligible follow-up and omit a consumed answer

name: Test an answer and acknowledge successful consumption — repeated or lost follow-up.
test: 15 the UI follow-up consumes the oracle answer and records a durable completion

name: Approve, reject, and hand off review items — missing rationale, actor, or destination.
test: 16 review requires a rejection reason, accepts another finding, and hands it off

name: Refuse a stale decision without losing the draft — second operator overwrites first.
test: 17 an answered claim makes an open browser draft stale without losing its text

name: Review and download evidence from the keyboard — actionable finding inaccessible.
test: 18 keyboard review opens persisted finding evidence and returns to the claim

name: Delegate setup and plan and verify the record — prose or mismatched actor stands in for a receipt.
test: Delegate setup and plan and verify the record — prose or mismatched actor stands in for a receipt.

name: Answer, revise, and approve the named revision — execution against the wrong revision.
test: Answer, revise, and approve the named revision — execution against the wrong revision.

name: Run ready tests and report blocked tests — partial execution misreported complete.
test: Run ready tests and report blocked tests — partial execution misreported complete.

name: Finish with a finding and export JUnit/JSON — CI receives an incorrect outcome.
test: Answer, revise, and approve the named revision — execution against the wrong revision.

name: Run a narrow retest with prerequisites and regressions — uncovered tests silently accepted.
test: Run a narrow retest with prerequisites and regressions — uncovered tests silently accepted.

name: Run a two-instance matrix and accept each latest result — one pass masks another instance’s failure.
test: Run a two-instance matrix and accept each latest result — one pass masks another instance’s failure.

name: Request, allow, and deny a host tool through the UI — hung prompt or incorrect decision.
test: 25 one browser answer resolves a real host permission request
limit: Packaged hook with synthetic host requests, not an authentic native permission prompt.

name: Stop only one tester and keep the others running — sibling workers killed.
test: Stop only one tester and keep the others running — sibling workers killed.

name: Interrupt the supervisor and retry safely — orphan workers or duplicate testing.
test: Interrupt the supervisor and retry safely — orphan workers or duplicate testing.

name: Resume a structured run after a worker deadline — outcomes lost or gate bypassed.
test: Resume a structured run after a worker deadline — outcomes lost or gate bypassed.

name: Show a safe provider failure and retained partial usage — secret visible or usage silently zero.
test: Show a safe provider failure and retained partial usage — secret visible or usage silently zero.
limit: Controlled Pi stream; the local timeout is accelerated.

name: Resume a chat turn and change its model — wrong native session, context, or charge.
test: Resume a chat turn and change its model — wrong native session, context, or charge.
limit: Controlled Claude protocol process; no live provider or model judgment.

name: Trigger one fixed ticket with a pinned build — ambiguous input or wrong checkout.
reason: The fixture binds a ticket hash to explicit build labels; a real Factory checkout and historical campaign trigger are not verified.
test: Factory pins a ticket to built previews, retains failed evidence, and promotes only a passing retest

name: Pause for a human choice and resume from an archived campaign — lost decision or nonportable state.
reason: A copied Checkmate workspace resumes after an oracle answer; historical campaign archive and resumption are unavailable.
test: Factory pins a ticket to built previews, retains failed evidence, and promotes only a passing retest

name: Reach a real built preview with deterministic seed data — QA runs against an empty/wrong app.
test: Factory pins a ticket to built previews, retains failed evidence, and promotes only a passing retest
limit: A disposable external Factory fixture builds and seeds the preview; a production Factory is not exercised.

name: Retain QA after a verification failure and label the failed check — bad candidate incorrectly promoted.
reason: A failed QA assertion and its evidence prevent promotion; a separate Factory candidate-verification failure is not exercised.
test: Factory pins a ticket to built previews, retains failed evidence, and promotes only a passing retest

name: Carry evidence into the fix and retest the next build — duplicated work or stale claims.
reason: The broken result and evidence survive a fixed-build retest; the fixture does not prove a Factory consumed that evidence to produce the fix.
test: Factory pins a ticket to built previews, retains failed evidence, and promotes only a passing retest

name: Stop on budget and close the preview and browser — unbounded loop, leaked processes, or unavailable evidence.
reason: External previews are stopped and observed exiting, but the historical campaign budget and browser lifecycle owner are unavailable.
test: Factory pins a ticket to built previews, retains failed evidence, and promotes only a passing retest

name: Refuse an older workspace without changing its database.
test: Refuse an older workspace without changing its database.

name: Retry a held database transaction — lost or duplicate edits.
test: Retry a held database transaction — lost or duplicate edits.

name: Reconnect live activity after a gap — review shows stale ownership or misses events.
test: 39 the packaged activity stream replays only events after its cursor

name: Find by current build and download report offline — wrong build or broken artifact.
test: 40 select the current build and download its evidence-backed report for offline review

name: Keep a refused form in a no-JS browser — data loss or unusable correction.
test: 41 no-JS refused decision keeps the entered text for correction

name: Recover a local UI restart with existing operation history — stuck Activity, hidden attempts, or divergent status.
test: 42 the packaged UI restarts and accepts a form using persisted record state

name: Drop and use a project tool recipe from the packed CLI
test: Drop and use a project tool recipe from the packed CLI
